name: Diverter

diverted.label: Diverted
diverted.desc: Push the blade across the lane to deflect cargo. This is the state it starts in; Use cycles it by hand. While a program drives the tag below, that program owns it instead.

divertTime.label: Divert time (s)
divertTime.desc: How long the blade takes to travel the full stroke, out or back. Too slow and cargo passes before the blade arrives.

divertDistance.label: Divert distance (m)
divertDistance.desc: How far the blade travels across the lane. Size it so the blade pushes cargo clear of the running surface rather than leaving it straddling the edge.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

tag.label: Extend tag (true extends the pusher)
tag.desc: Extend the pusher from the program. While a program drives this tag it OWNS the diverter, so a hand Use in pilot mode is refused with "In auto - PLC controlled".
